newsitem.title: INDIA: India Marvel Vinyls, Korea General Plastic to link.
newsitem.headline: India Marvel Vinyls, Korea General Plastic to link.

text.p: India's Marvel Vinyls Ltd said on Wednesday it was launching a joint venture with Korea General Plastic Ind Co Ltd to make polyvinyl chloride (PVC) flooring and tiles in India.
Under the joint venture agreement, the Korean firm will shift its plant from South Korea to the western coastal Indian city of Silvassa, Marvel said in a statement.
The venture, to be formally announced on Thursday, will be a 100 percent export-oriented unit, it said. The new unit is expected to start commercial production by March 1998.

Marvel said the Korean firm would obtain equity against the cost of plant and machinery and provide technical expertise to the venture, while the Indian partner would bear the cost of land and buildings as part of its equity share.
It said Marvel would be the majority partner but gave no other details.

The joint venture envisages an initial turnover of around 300 million rupees ($8.38 million), which could grow to nearly two billion rupees within the next two years, a company spokesman told Reuters.
